requirements.summary: Update CosmeticItem component to display generated product images below item name, replacing the sparkles icon placeholder
acceptanceCriteria: Product images render below the cosmetic item name
Images are properly sized and styled to fit the card layout
Fallback handling exists if an image fails to load

file_operations.description: Replace the sparkles icon placeholder with an img element that loads the product image from frontend/public/assets/generated using a slug derived from the item name. Add proper sizing, styling to fit the card layout maintaining the warm coral/peach theme, and fallback handling if the image fails to load. Ensure the image renders below the item name in the designated space.
